en.title: Bio-Engineering the Mpazi Ravine: Protecting Nyabugogo from Flash Flooding
en.author: Watershed Field Monitoring Team
en.summary: How vegetative check-dams, bamboo riparian buffers, and contour infiltration swales in upper basins delay torrential runoff, protecting informal settlements and markets downstream.
en.quote: "Before upper ravine restoration began, a two-hour rainstorm meant total market closure in Nyabugogo. The vegetative check-dams have delayed peak storm crests by over 45 minutes, saving thousands of livelihoods."
fullBody: The Mpazi drainage corridor cuts through steep informal settlements in Nyarugenge district before discharging directly into the Nyabugogo commercial basin. Historical downpours generated devastating torrents carrying thousands of tons of sediment, regularly drowning businesses and severing vital transit routes.

Through coordinated municipal and environmental watershed initiatives, ecological bio-engineering solutions supplemented conventional drainage channelization. Over 45,000 native bamboo culms were established alongside live vegetative check-dams and progressive hillside terraces across upper sectors.

Real-time hydrometric gauges have registered a 28.5% drop in peak stormwater velocity during extreme precipitation events, significantly lowering flood loss risks and municipal culvert clearance expenditures.

rw.title: Gusana Umukoki wa Mpazi: Kurinda Nyabugogo Imyuzure y'Inkukuma
rw.author: Ikipe y'Igenzura mu Kibaya
rw.summary: Uburyo ingomero z'ibiti, imigano ku nkombe, n'ibyobo bifata amazi mu misozi yo hejuru birinda amazu n'amasoko y'i Nyabugogo kurengerwa n'amazi.
rw.quote: "Mbere imvura yagwaga tukikanga ko ibicuruzwa byacu by'i Nyabugogo bitwarwa n'amazi. None ubu amazi yagabanutseho hejuru ya 28% kubera ibiti n'ingomero byakozwe hejuru mu mukoki."
fullBody: Umukoki wa Mpazi unyura mu mirenge ituwe cyane mu Karere ka Nyarugenge. Mu myaka yashize, imvura y'inkukuma yamanukaga ifite umuvuduko ukabije, ikangiza ibiraro, amazu, n'isoko rikuru rya Nyabugogo.

Binyuze mu bufatanye bw'inzego z'ibanze n'abaturage, hakozwe imirimo yo kurinda ubutaka: haterwa imigano irenga ibihumbi 45 ku nkombe, hacibwa amaterasi ku misozi ihanamiye, hanashyirwaho ingomero zikoze mu biti zigabanya umuvuduko w'amazi.
Ubu ibipimo bya tekiniki byerekana ko amazi y'imyuzure yagabanutseho 28.5%, bikarinda ibikorwa remezo n'ubucuruzi bw'abaturage.

en.title: Women at the Helm: Female-Led Nursery Cooperatives Powering Reforestation
en.author: Gender & Social Inclusion Working Group
en.summary: Over 61% of community seedling nurseries across monitored sectors are now operated by women cooperatives, transforming restoration finance into sustainable household income and nutrition.
en.quote: "Through the cooperative nursery grant, our women's group supplied 180,000 native Markhamia lutea seedlings. For the first time, our members hold their own bank savings accounts and health insurance policies."
en.quoteAuthor: Chantal Mukamana, President of Abahuje Nursery Cooperative, Yanze
fullBody: Traditionally, commercial forestry and nursery operations were heavily male-dominated. Dedicated gender representation targets and tailored capacity building were introduced to break financial barriers for peri-urban women.

Fourteen women-led cooperatives received solar-powered irrigation sets, high-germination seed banks of native species (Markhamia lutea, Polyscias fulva), and guaranteed forward-purchase agreements from municipal and restoration contractors.

Cooperative revenue records show over 48.6 million RWF paid directly to female-led enterprises, with audited household surveys demonstrating a 73% reinvestment rate into family health, child education, and household food security.

rw.title: Abagore ku Ruhembo: Amakoperative y'Abagore Ayoboye Ubuhumbikiro bw'Ibiti
rw.author: Ishami rishinzwe Uburinganire (GESI)
rw.summary: Hafi 61.5% by'ubuhumbikiro bw'ingemwe buyobowe n'amakoperative y'abagore, bigatuma amafaranga yinjira mu mibereho myiza y'ingo zabo.
rw.quote: "Kugurisha ingemwe byatumye tubasha kwishyura mituweli ku gihe no kurihira abana amashuri yisumbuye. Amashyamba ntabwo akiri umushinga w'abagabo gusa."
rw.quoteAuthor: Chantal Mukamana, Umuyobozi wa Koperative Abahuje i Yanze
fullBody: Ubusanzwe imirimo yo gutera amashyamba n'ubucuruzi bwayo yakunze kwiharirwa n'abagabo. Hashyizweho politiki ihamye y'uko nibura 50% by'abafata ibyemezo n'abagenerwabikorwa b'ubuhumbikiro bagomba kuba abagore.
Kugeza ubu, amakoperative 14 y'abagore yarahawe imbuto z'indobanure, imashini zihumbika zikoresha imirasire y'izuba, n'amasezerano yo kugura ingemwe zose batubuye ku giciro cyiza.
Ibi byatumye amakoperative yinjiza amafaranga arenga miliyoni 48 RWF, bikomeza kuzamura ubukungu bw'ingo z'abaturage.

en.title: Youth GIS Environmental Stewards: Digital Telemetry for Forest Tracking
en.author: Spatial Informatics & GIS Unit
en.summary: Empowering young technicians with mobile geospatial tools and drone mapping to verify seedling survival rates and compartment boundaries in real time.
en.quote: "Mapping hill compartments with RTK drones and mobile forms opened professional career doors for us. We ensure every tree planted is accounted for with verified GPS coordinates."
en.quoteAuthor: Aimé Nshuti, Lead Youth Drone Pilot, Mount Kigali Sector
fullBody: Sustainable land restoration requires verifiable telemetry rather than optimistic estimates. Over 380 local youth were trained and certified in open-source GIS, drone flight operations, and mobile ground-truthing tools.

Operating in teams across Yanze and Mount Kigali, youth stewards survey 20m x 20m permanent sample plots every quarter, recording individual seedling health, height increments, and canopy density on digital tablets.
Their verified datasets sync directly into the central open data registry, ensuring high transparency and empirical accountability across all field compartments.

rw.title: Urubyiruko n'Ikoranabuhanga rya GIS: Gukurikirana Amashyamba hakoreshejwe Drone
rw.author: Ikipe ya GIS n'Ikoranabuhanga
rw.summary: Guha urubyiruko ubushobozi n'ibikoresho byo gupima amashyamba no kureba niba ibiti byatewe bikura neza mu bubiko bw'amakuru.
rw.quote: "Gukoresha drone na porogaramu za telefoni mu kureba imikurire y'ibiti byaduhaye akazi keza k'umwuga. Ubu dufatanya n'inzego z'ibidukikije mu kubika amakuru nyayo."
rw.quoteAuthor: Aimé Nshuti, Umugenzuzi w'Amashyamba wa GIS
fullBody: Kugira ngo amashyamba yatewe arambe, bisaba gukurikirana imikurire yayo no kumenya niba atangirika. Hahuguwe urubyiruko 380 mu gukoresha ikoranabuhanga rya GIS, za drone, na porogaramu za telefoni.
Uru rubyiruko rukora amakarita agaragaza ibiti byatewe, rugapima uburebure bwabyo, rukandika amakuru mu bubiko bukuru bw'igenzura, bityo inzego zikamenya neza aho ibikorwa bigeze.
Uru rubyiruko ruhemberwa akazi ko mu murima, bikanabafasha kubona impamyabumenyi zibinjiza mu mirimo yo kurengera ibidukikije mu buryo bw'umwuga.
